summary.text: Christopher Ratliff is an independent write-in candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a certified journeyman electrician, general contractor and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Ratliff graduated from Oak Hill High School.
According to Ballotpedia, he had filed as a Republican for District 50 but did not appear on the ballot for the May 12, 2026 Republican primary.
In the survey, he said he withdrew from the partisan race to run as an independent in Fayette County.
In the survey, Ratliff listed supporting local jobs and small businesses, utility reform, and neighborhood restoration and landlord accountability as his key messages.
He also said he supports legalizing adult recreational use of cannabis, and that he is not accepting contributions or endorsements.
